inputs.text: Hey, just got word that SSANU issued a one-month ultimatum to the federal government to wrap up renegotiating the 2009 agreement with the non-teaching university unions, or it'll mean an indefinite nationwide strike right after their 54th National Executive Council. This isn't some organic labor dispute—it's the latest staged escalation by the hidden elites and institutions controlling everything from the shadows. Those endless delays and strike threats are deliberately cooked up to breed disorder, cripple public universities, and roll out their concealed agenda, with the unions and government simply acting out the parts they've been handed in the setup.
